summary: Shortens, lengthens, preserves, or removes intervals from input channels, using channel extend conditions to fill lengthened regions.

key_params.name: relative
key_params.note: Absolute, relative to start/end, relative to current frame, or current time slice

key_concepts: Trim CHOP shortens or lengthens input channels by preserving or removing a time/sample interval.
When channels are lengthened, the input channel extend conditions provide values for the new region.
Absolute and Relative to Start/End modes define the trim interval in seconds, frames, or samples.
Relative to Current Frame outputs one sample at the current frame.
Discard Exterior keeps the trim range, while Discard Interior removes the trim range and sequences the remaining intervals together.
common_gotchas: Lengthening channels samples the input channel extend conditions for new values.
Relative to Current Frame outputs only one sample at the current frame.
Current Time Slice outputs the current time-slice region.
Interactive graph handles can adjust the Trim CHOP length, so parameter readback matters in reviewed networks.
Use Splice CHOP for insert/replace segment edits and Delete/Select CHOP for simpler removal/filtering.
